channel.title: South Coast Business Awards 2018 - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: 'Critical gaps' in port expansion plans amid environmental concerns
item.description: A parish council says a port operator’s plans for a vehicle import and export terminal has “critical gaps” and is “unclear”.

item.title: Drivers warned of city centre delays as nine ships set to be in Southampton
item.description: Southampton is gearing up for a busy spell of cruise traffic as nine ships call in the port over the next week.

item.title: Severely depressed woman arrested for arson - all because she hated Eastleigh
item.description: Marjorie Jordan told police that a man had attacked her at the shop she and her husband had bought 18 months ago and was going to set it alight.

item.title: Police set to deploy facial recognition to hunt criminals and missing people
item.description: Police in Hampshire have revealed the county’s first live facial recognition vans will be deployed in Southampton next week with technology set to target the city's most dangerous offenders

item.title: New fears over 'vital' ferry service halted for 16 months
item.description: New fears have been voiced about the future of the Hythe Ferry - 16 months after sailings were suspended

item.title: Two-bedroom bungalow in Bitterne Park up for sale for £325,000
item.description: A "spacious" two-bedroom bungalow is up for sale. The home features a conservatory, off-road parking, bay windows, and a large garden.

item.title: Shock as man, 65, dies in hospital after falling in bar
item.description: A man from Chandler's Ford has died after falling in a Winchester bar

item.title: Great Oaks pupils pay final respects to former head as hearse passes school
item.description: Pupils gathered as the funeral procession of Great Oaks School’s executive headteacher made a final visit to the school he dedicated two decades to leading.

item.title: 'Thank you for being the best': Sister's tribute to alleged murder victim
item.description: The sister of an 18-year-old student who was allegedly murdered in Southampton has paid a moving tribute to her "amazing" sibling

item.title: 'He lit up a room' - Family mourns 18-year-old student killed in Southampton
item.description: A family have paid tribute to Henry Nowak, 18, who was tragically killed on a night out in Southampton.
